# Message Kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MessageKind`](gmeow-MessageKind.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MessageKind>

The behavioral or report kind of a message — a VALUE vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Categories can overlap (a bounce is also auto-generated; a read receipt is also auto-generated). [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9): no single category wins.
